Moved the plugin abilities frenzy, lowhp, veteran, trample and shield into one class each behind the new interface Ability (ServiceLoader, services file with merge=union); a new ability now adds one class and one line, no change of AoePlugin.java. PR #4616 (one merge conflict with the Fire Lancer PR solved). Next: the other abilities can move one class at a time; the last criterion (health.py --prs 50) needs 50 more merged PRs.
